description: This is a test source file for the ModuleConfigDTD component of the OpenMRS project, specifically testing XML validation and compatibility for version 1.5. It contains parameterized unit tests that generate XML configurations, validate them against a DTD, and verify proper handling of module versioning.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_5
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating XML configuration files for OpenMRS module using DTD validation, focusing on version 1.5 compatibility.

methods.name: validXmlWithMultipleAwareOfModules
methods.description: Parameterized test verifying that generated XML with multiple modules is valid according to the DTD.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DOM Document object to a formatted XML string.

methods.name: validXmlWithMissingVersion
methods.description: Tests that XML configurations missing a version are still considered valid.

methods.name: xmlFailsWithNoModules
methods.description: Ensures that XML with no module specified fails validation.
